evals.prompt: Прадед — Хаим Натензон, мещанин Сквирского уезда, родился около 1850. Хочу найти его семью в ревизии 1858 года. Скачать весь том и читать подряд?
evals.expected_output: Does not start with straight-through reading. First checks the surname against the project's registry of unread sections and makes a list of spellings (Натензон, Натансон, Нотензон, without the first letter). Goes to the j-roots surname indexes: the topic «СКВИРА и СКВИРСКИЙ уезд», the post with the files DAKO 280-2-1012 (1850) and 280-2-1490 (1858), where surnames are listed by shtetl under spoilers; explains that forum search requires a login (the person does that), and without a login — a search engine restricted to forum.j-roots.info; saves the post with curl and parses it locally with forum_post_index.py, because innerText loses the spoilers. Matches the surname to the file title and the shtetl section, takes the full PDF link from the href, reads the whole shtetl section from the scan, and records what was read in the registry. Treats an index row as a hint until checked against the scan.

evals.prompt: Агент в сентябре читал том ревизии 1834 года по Бердичеву, но только ради одной фамилии, и нашёл там нашу семью. Теперь всплыла фамилия жены прадеда — Гуревич. Надо ли перечитывать том?
evals.expected_output: First checks the registry of unread sections and the coverage log: which frames and sections were read and how — selectively for one surname or straight through with all families written out. Explains that a selective reading for surname A does not mean the volume has been read for surname B. If there is no registry, creates one from the template assets/unread-sections-registry.md. Then checks the surname indexes (j-roots for Berdychiv, JewishGen, genealogyindexer) for all forms of the wife's surname and narrows the reading to the sections where the index shows it; reads them from the scan and closes the registry row. Warns that a zero in an index does not prove absence from the file.

evals.prompt: Открыла тему на j-roots про Бердичев, там список фамилий по делу, но моей фамилии Зильберман нет, хотя в семье говорили, что они бердичевские цеховые. Значит, их там нет?
evals.expected_output: Answers no: an index is not the document and is sometimes incomplete. Checks whether part of the list is hidden in «Показать» [Show] spoilers (innerText and copying text skip them) — fetches the whole post as HTML and parses it locally. Searches truncated forms (without the first letter, Сильберман, Зилберман, -манн), checks whether the list is repeated in other topics, and looks by place: which Berdychiv files have been itemised (guild lists, revisions of different years) and which have not. Puts the unitemised files into the plan for straight-through reading from the scan on Commons, with an entry in the registry. States a negative conclusion only with source, forms, method and coverage. Does not suggest writing to an archive.
